method: Hand-read from the primary HTML document of each 10-K on SEC EDGAR. No XBRL APIs, no R*.htm renderings, no FilingSummary.xml, no third-party sites.

filings.fiscal_period_statement: Fiscal year - Our fiscal year ends on the Saturday nearest January 31. ... Fiscal 2023 ended February 3, 2024, and consisted of 53 weeks. Fiscal 2022 and 2021 ended January 28, 2023, and January 29, 2022, respectively, and consisted of 52 weeks. Fiscal 2024 will end February 1, 2025, and will consist of 52 weeks.
filings.statement_footnote: Note: 2023 consisted of 53 weeks compared with 52 weeks in 2022 and 2021.

filings.fiscal_period_statement: Fiscal year Our fiscal year ends on the Saturday nearest January 31. ... Fiscal 2016 ended January 28, 2017, and consisted of 52 weeks. Fiscal 2015 ended January 30, 2016, and consisted of 52 weeks. Fiscal 2014 ended January 31, 2015, and consisted of 52 weeks. Fiscal 2017 will end February 3, 2018, and will consist of 53 weeks.
